listing.summary: Direct video files and torrents from the sites OpenScrapers read that still answer, each one switchable.
listing.description: A port of the Kodi add-on OpenScrapers (GPL-3.0, a4k-openproject) to a Playpex plugin. Of its 130 scrapers, the ones whose sites still answer and give something Playpex plays: direct files from BnW Movies (public-domain black-and-white films) and netzkino (free German streaming, licensed for Germany, Austria and Switzerland only: off by default), and torrents from LimeTorrents, TorrentDownload and Nyaa (anime). Sites that only link to file hosts, need an account, hide behind Cloudflare or are gone are left out.
listing.disclaimer: Streaming copyrighted content may be illegal where you live. Educational project. The scrapers' logic comes from OpenScrapers (GPL-3.0).
